name: worktrees
description: A chip with your git worktrees and a pane that shows each one's branch, uncommitted changes and pull request, opens it in the app's Terminal and removes the clean ones whose branch is merged.

roots.title: Roots
roots.description: Comma-separated folders that hold your repos (e.g. ~/code). Each repo inside them with worktrees is listed, besides the session's own repo.

pollMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often the worktrees are read.

ghPath.title: gh path
ghPath.description: Full path to the GitHub CLI when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees. Without gh, merged branches are found with git alone.
